declarations.description:
Render a validated, bounded generated view using a host-owned component catalog.
Stable node identities retain control DOM and dirty values across increasing revisions.
Model data cannot choose module paths, event listeners, HTML, or action permissions.

Native form nodes contain form-associated Lyra controls. Their own validation and reset
contracts remain active; this renderer is a form container, not a form-associated control.
Submit actions without an explicit payload receive the current bound values.

Read-only status and busy describe renderer readiness. The host aria-busy attribute is
managed by this component. Ready means encountered modules and generated child updates
have settled; it does not certify remote data or media loaded independently by a child.
Readiness never moves focus or announces completion automatically.
declarations.name: LyraGenViewElement

cssProperties.description: Default reserved block size during loading.
cssProperties.name: --lr-gen-loading-block-size

cssParts.description: A generated component added or changed by the latest ready revision of the same surface; cleared at the next ready revision. Unstyled by default, so a host highlight (for example a short animation) is opt-in and should respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
cssParts.name: changed

cssParts.description: Non-interactive fallback that replaces one component contained by `recovery="isolate"`.
cssParts.name: isolated

members.name: failureCategories
members.description: Optional local observation of coarse failure categories; receives no source or diagnostic details.

members.name: limits
members.description: Host resource limits; omitted values keep defaults and overrides cannot exceed hard ceilings.

members.name: recovery
members.description:
Validation recovery. `strict` (default; any other value behaves as strict) rejects the whole view on
any error; `isolate` replaces only a component-local defective node by a localized fallback with
part `isolated` and keeps every other node, its state, focus and actions.

members.name: document
members.description: Complete view; publish a higher revision to patch the same surface.

members.name: catalog
members.description: Trusted catalog; only its declared tags, properties, and loaders are used.

members.name: bindingState
members.description: Initial values, or authoritative values in controlled mode. Reassignment replaces local state.

members.name: liveData
controlled
members.description: Emit edit proposals and keep displaying bindingState until the host updates it.

members.name: enabledActions
members.description: Optional host allowlist that further narrows the catalog's action permissions.

members.name: confirmAction
members.description: Host-only confirmation callback for catalog actions marked confirm.

members.name: status
members.description: Current renderer state; a disconnected nonempty view is interrupted.

members.name: busy
members.description: Whether current document admission, module loading, or child rendering is pending.

members.name: restoreSnapshot
members.description: Restore a validated view and its dirty binding ownership silently; no action is replayed.

members.name: elementForNode
members.description:
The rendered element of a generated node in the current committed revision, or `undefined`
when the id is unknown, still loading, failed or isolated. Element identity is stable across
revisions and keyed reorders while the node keeps its id and type; every rendered element also
carries `data-gen-id` and `data-gen-type`. Use it to highlight, scroll to or annotate a node,
never to change generated properties.

members.name: reset
members.description: Reset generated native forms to their accepted defaults and publish state proposals.

events.description: Once per successfully rendered surface revision, after child updates settle; `changes` lists the node ids added, changed or removed since the previous ready revision of the same surface.
events.name: lr-gen-ready

events.description: A validated host action request; no work is executed.
events.name: lr-gen-action

events.description: User edit or reset proposal, including complete bound values.
events.name: lr-gen-state-change
